sources.label: High-rate GNSS (u-blox 10 Hz) patches for NAVER Map and KakaoMap car navigation,
sources.author: kmaps-nav-patches
patch_list: Lets the location SDK use every GNSS fix (up to 25 Hz) while KNSDK keeps its 1 Hz origin rate, and fixes a map-matching result chain that leaked memory for the whole drive.
